full_judgment: The opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff has instituted a suit bearing O.C. Suit No. 528 of 1982 in the court of Munsif, Nawabganj for declaration of her title in the suit property. The case of the plaintiff opposite party No. 1 is that tile suit land originally belonged to Rashiklal Biswas who sold the same to one Sudhir Kumar Biswas. There was a suit between him and the ex-landlord Mohammad Ali Chowdhury regarding the suit land. The said suit ended in compromise but due to mistake plot No. 737/1916 under Khatian No. 260/1 was written in place of plot No. 737/1916, Sudhir Kumar Biswas sold the suit land to the plaintiff and since then the plaintiff is in possession of the same. The land was wrongly recorded during revisional settlement operation, Afzal Hossain (the petitioner) and others were trying to take settlement of the land and the Circle Officer (Revenue) disclosed about the settlement when he went for local inspection. The title of the plaintiff has become clouded as her right, title and possession in the suit land was denied. The opposite No. 2 as the vested and non-resident property Management Committee, Nawabganj represented by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Nawabganj has filed written 'statement denying the claim of the plaintiff opposite party No. 1 stating inter-alia that the suit is not maintainable, that the suit is bad for defect of parties and that Sudhir Kumar Biswas while owning and possessing the property left for India for good sometime after 1965 and started living there permanently, the property was first declared as abandoned property under the Defence of Pakistan Rules and thereafter as non-resident and vested property and that plaintiff opposite party No. 1 has no right, title and interest and possession in the same. The petitioner having come to learn of the suit filed a petition under Order 1 Rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure on 29.12.84 for being added as-a defendant stating that he has been in possession of the suit property taking lease from the Government as abandoned property and has paid rent upto the current year. It has also been stated in the petition that the petitioner came to know of the suit on 29.12.84 from the office of the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue). It is alleged that the plaintiff has filed the suit with misrepresentation and suppression of fact with the motive of obtaining a decree keeping away the petitioner from the suit though as a matter of fact the petitioner is in possession of the suit property as a lessee.
